summary: Reduce avoidable database wake probes, consolidate prelaunch recovery parents with safe schedule-mode sync, and bound mobile QA revalidation by app lifecycle and operational mode. Local source only, free plans, no deployment.
noAssistantImpact: Operational efficiency only. No merchant command, assistant tool, permission, entitlement, confirmation, financial invariant, retention duration or Prisma schema change. Both recovery groups remain under one half-hourly parent in explicit prelaunch mode; hourly/daily retention and standard schedules are preserved. Release/smoke readiness remains database-backed. Future runtime activation and measured savings require separate target authorization.

evidence.result: Injected HTTP requests prove routine API discovery reaches only /live; explicit database and QA readiness retain connected failures and environment checks.
Selected profile owns schedule mode; sync includes it, defaults explicitly to standard when omitted, rejects invalid mode and removes inherited parent values.
All recovery steps run exactly once across active prelaunch parents; hourly/daily memberships retained; retired fifteen-minute parent has zero steps; failed work probe does not dispatch child.

Isolated child mounts real provider with real QueryObservers: minute polling stops in background/offline, retained refreshes cannot bypass live-state guard, resume revalidates once, no authorization or Production client creates no QA poll.
